_comment: fn_tables_stakes_follows_its_own_blinds backs the BEFORE UPDATE trigger zzzzzz_tables_stakes_follows_its_own_blinds on public.tables. It keeps stakes equal to trim_scale(small_blind)/trim_scale(big_blind) for tournament tables. The INSERT side is fn_tournament_table_inherits_committed_blinds, which already existed and was BEFORE INSERT only, which is why a minutely cron UPDATE had been maintaining this column for 40,998 rows it could not reach. Cash tables are excluded in both the WHEN clause and the body.
